title: Dropdown Menu
description: A menu that opens from a button, with actions, checkbox and radio items, labelled groups and destructive entries, such as account or sort options.

components.DropdownMenu: Groups all parts of the dropdown menu.
components.DropdownMenuCheckboxItem: Lets the user switch an option on or off from the menu.
components.DropdownMenuContent: Holds the entries the dropdown menu shows while open.
components.DropdownMenuGroup: Groups related entries of the dropdown menu.
components.DropdownMenuItem: Holds one action the user can pick from the dropdown menu.
components.DropdownMenuLabel: Labels a group of entries in the dropdown menu.
components.DropdownMenuPortal: Places the menu content above the rest of the page.
components.DropdownMenuRadioGroup: Groups radio items so the user can pick exactly one.
components.DropdownMenuRadioItem: Lets the user choose one option from a group in the menu.
components.DropdownMenuSeparator: Separates groups of entries in the dropdown menu.
components.DropdownMenuShortcut: Shows the keyboard shortcut for a menu item.
components.DropdownMenuSub: Groups a submenu trigger with the nested menu it opens.
components.DropdownMenuSubContent: Holds the entries the submenu shows while open.
components.DropdownMenuSubTrigger: Opens a submenu from an item of the dropdown menu.
components.DropdownMenuTrigger: Opens and closes the dropdown menu.
